audit_items.proof_trace: The implementation correctly uses SSZ HashTreeRoot for empty ExecutionRequests (three empty lists merkleized separately then combined). The property assertion appears to conflate SSZ hashing with raw sha256(""). SSZ HashTreeRoot of an empty ExecutionRequests structure produces a valid Merkle tree root (3 empty list nodes), not the literal sha256 of zero bytes. This is correct behavior per Ethereum SSZ specification.
